progressiveHints.text: Choose one situation where you would naturally use Vたことがあります / Vたことがありません; do not write the whole sentence yet.
Build the sentence in parts: choose the content first, then check the form that carries say whether you have had an experience at any time.
Compare your form, meaning, and neutral polite conversation with the worked model. Change the content so the response is your own.
